file_desc.max.description: The maximum number of file descriptors.

cpu.description: The recent system CPU usage as a percentage.

load_1m.description: The load average for the most recent minute.

load_5m.description: The load average for the last five minutes.

load_15m.description: The load average for the last fifteen minutes.

available_processors.description: The number of available processors (logical CPU cores available to the JVM).

node.role.description:
The roles of the node.
Returned values include `c`(cold node), `d`(data node), `f`(frozen node), `h`(hot node), `i`(ingest node), `l`(machine learning node), `m` (master eligible node), `r`(remote cluster client node), `s`(content node), `t`(transform node), `v`(voting-only node), `w`(warm node),and `-`(coordinating node only).

master.description:
Indicates whether the node is the elected master node.
Returned values include `*`(elected master) and `-`(not elected master).

get.current.description: The number of current get ops.

get.exists_time.description: The time spent in successful gets.

get.exists_total.description: The number of successful get operations.

get.missing_time.description: The time spent in failed gets.

indexing.index_current.description: The number of current indexing operations.

indexing.index_failed.description: The number of failed indexing operations.

merges.current_docs.description: The number of current merging docs.

merges.total.description: The number of completed merge operations.

refresh.external_time.description: The time spent in external refreshes.

refresh.listeners.description: The number of pending refresh listeners.

script.cache_evictions.description: The total compiled scripts evicted from the cache.

script.compilation_limit_triggered.description: The script cache compilation limit triggered.

search.fetch_time.description: The time spent in fetch phase.

search.query_time.description: The time spent in query phase.

search.scroll_time.description: The time scroll contexts held open.

segments.index_writer_memory.description: The memory used by the index writer.

segments.version_map_memory.description: The memory used by the version map.

segments.fixed_bitset_memory.description: The memory used by fixed bit sets for nested object field types and export type filters for types referred in _parent fields.

suggest.current.description: The number of current suggest operations.

bulk.total_operations.description: The number of bulk shard operations.

bulk.total_time.description: The time spend in shard bulk.

bulk.total_size_in_bytes.description: The total size in bytes of shard bulk.

bulk.avg_time.description: The average time spend in shard bulk.

bulk.avg_size_in_bytes.description: The average size in bytes of shard bulk.
